svg.title: Jobs reachable within 45 minutes by public transport in the Helsinki capital region
svg.desc: A map of Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen covered by 250 m cells coloured by the number of jobs reachable within 45 minutes walking and by public transport at the morning peak. The centre of Helsinki and the cells along the metro and the railway lines reach the most, over 250 thousand jobs; the edges of Espoo and Vantaa reach fewer than 25 thousand.

g.text: Walking and HSL's buses, trams, metro, trains and ferries, departures 07:30–08:30 on Tuesday
17 November 2026 (median), from 5,825 cells of 250 m with 1,253,793 residents to 486,976 jobs in
companies and non-profits. The average resident reaches 151,537 of them (31%); 22% of residents
reach at least half. Dot: Helsinki Central Station
Jobs within 45 minutes by public transport, Helsinki capital region
